correctness.rationale: The edge-sign flux identity in any period-two state forces each active edge sign to reverse and tied edges to remain tied. On a bistar with a,b≥1 leaves, a tied leaf-hub edge would force a fixed state; all active leaf edges at a hub have the same sign. Three feasible strict-bridge sign classes and the additional tied-bridge class only when a=b give disjoint canonical representatives. Their bounded integer gaps yield the full formula (a+b+1)(a+1)^a(b+1)^b+(a-b+1)_+(a+1)^a(b-1)^b+(b-a+1)_+(a-1)^a(b+1)^b+1_{a=b}a^{2a}. Translation changes sum by n=a+b+2, establishing residue-polynomial counts; explicit minima over both phase coordinates establish the nonnegative generating function and unique minimum S=n-2 balanced, n-1 unbalanced. Independently exhaustive bounded canonical comparisons gave counts 13,72,72,439,640,3584 for six tested (a,b) and verified both-phase minimum resources. Infinite formulas follow from the gap parametrization, not finite enumeration.
